description: This PHP class 'Serializer' in the Laminas\Diactorosequest namespace provides methods for serializing and deserializing HTTP request messages. It implements functionality to convert Request objects to strings and parse strings or streams back into Request objects, including handling request line parsing, headers, and request target processing.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Final class providing serialization/deserialization of HTTP request messages, converting between Request objects and string/stream representations.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Request object from a request message string.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates a Request object from a stream containing the request message.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes a Request object into a string message.

methods.name: getRequestLine
methods.description: Internal method to parse the request line (method, target, version) from the stream.

methods.name: createUriFromRequestTarget
methods.description: Internal method to create a Uri object from the request target portion.
